title: iammojogo's Uncrafting Mod
description: This mod is a mod that allows users to uncraft crafted items to gain back resources from items they don't need and don't want to throw away or burn.
body:
Reverses crafting recipes with durability-based material returns. Place crafted items into the uncrafting table to retrieve their raw ingredients. Multi-output recipes (like doors, slabs) require full crafting sets to uncraft efficiently. Damaged tools return proportionally fewer materials.

COMPATIBILITY

Works with most mods. Uses server-side recipe detection - no hardcoded recipe lists.

Requirements:
Minecraft 1.21.11
Forge 61+
Required on both client and server
